by Mott T Greene: Introduction
莫特·T·格林著。: 引言

by Mott T Greene: This is a book about the life and scientific work of Alfred Wegener, whose reputation today rests with his theory of continental displacements, better known as ‘continental drift’.
莫特·T·格林著。: 本书讲述阿尔弗雷德·魏格纳的生平与科学工作。他今天享有的声誉，源于他提出的大陆位移学说，也就是人们更熟悉的“大陆漂移学说”。

by Mott T Greene: Wegener proposed this theory in 1912 and developed it extensively for nearly 20 years.
莫特·T·格林著。: 魏格纳于1912年提出这个学说，随后用将近二十年的时间不断充实这一学说。

by Mott T Greene: His book on the subject, The Origin of Continents and Oceans, went through four editions and was the focus of an international controversy in his lifetime and for some years after his death.
莫特·T·格林著。: 他就这一主题所著的《海陆的起源》共出过四版。在他生前及去世后的若干年里，这本书一直是国际争论的焦点。

by Mott T Greene: Wegener’s basic idea was that many mysteries about the Earth’s history could be solved if one supposed that the continents moved laterally, rather than supposing that they remained fixed in place.
莫特·T·格林著。: 魏格纳的基本观点是：如果假设大陆会横向移动，而非固定在原处，那么地球历史上的许多谜团便可能得到解答。
